Bird vignette

Mark Catesby, The Purple Jack Daw (Gracula Quiscula), published 1731–1743.
The engraving depicts the common grackle (Quiscalus quiscula). Etching and
engraving with hand coloring on laid paper. National Gallery of Art,
Washington. Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green, 1973.26.20.

The Gallery identifies this image as public domain. The Atlas vignette is
a cropped, background-isolated detail of the Gallery's scan.

Collection record and rights statement
https://www.nga.gov/artworks/53847-purple-jack-daw-gracula-quiscula
